goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE: use the select tool to select 'MAIN-001 - Main Office' in the Branch dropdown, type operator ID 'teller1', type password 'password', click Sign On. Click 'Member Inquiry', type member number '100234' into the search value field, click Search, click 'Select'. On the member record page, click 'Funds Transfer'. On the Funds Transfer form, the required field labels are prefixed with an asterisk, e.g. '* From Share', '* To Share', '* Amount' -- use those exact label texts (without the trailing colon) as the 'name' argument. Use the select tool to choose an OPEN-status share (NOT a HOLD share -- check the member record page you already saw for which shares are OPEN, e.g. a Certificate or Money Market share) as '* From Share', and select a DIFFERENT OPEN-status share as '* To Share'. Type '1.00' into '* Amount' and 'capability discovery run' into 'Memo'. Click 'Continue' to reach the confirmation review screen. Then click 'Post Transfer' to actually complete the transfer (this is sandbox data, completing it for real is fine and required). After the transfer posts, extract the confirmation number (the value next to the 'Confirmation:' label) as an output named confirmation_number. Then immediately call done referencing that output -- do not take any extra steps first.
final_summary: Signed on to MERIDIAN CORE as teller1, performed member inquiry for member 100234 (Lovelace, Ada), initiated a Funds Transfer from OPEN share 100234-MMKT-10 (Money Market) to OPEN share 100234-S0001-11 (Regular Shares) for $1.00 with memo 'capability discovery run', reviewed and posted the transfer. Transaction completed successfully with confirmation number CN480417.
